projects.title: CollabSpace
projects.description: Real-time collaboration platform for distributed teams with video, chat, and document editing.
projects.longDescription: CollabSpace is a comprehensive collaboration platform I built to solve the challenges of remote work. It combines video conferencing, real-time chat, and collaborative document editing in one seamless experience.
projects.challenge: Remote teams were juggling 5+ tools for communication and collaboration. Context switching was killing productivity, and important information was scattered across platforms.
projects.solution: Built an all-in-one platform with real-time sync using WebSockets, operational transformation for collaborative editing, and WebRTC for video. Implemented a plugin architecture allowing teams to customize their workspace.
results: Reduced tool switching by 70% for beta users

projects.title: ShopFlow
projects.description: E-commerce platform with AI-powered recommendations and real-time inventory management.
projects.longDescription: ShopFlow is a modern e-commerce solution that helps small businesses compete with major retailers through intelligent product recommendations and seamless checkout experiences.
projects.challenge: Small e-commerce businesses lacked access to sophisticated recommendation engines and struggled with inventory management across multiple sales channels.
projects.solution: Developed a full-stack platform with machine learning-powered recommendations, real-time inventory sync, and a one-click checkout flow. Integrated with Stripe for payments and built a custom analytics dashboard.
results: Zero inventory sync errors across channels

projects.title: DevMetrics
projects.description: Analytics platform for engineering teams to track productivity and code quality metrics.
projects.longDescription: DevMetrics helps engineering leaders make data-driven decisions by providing actionable insights into team productivity, code quality, and deployment frequency.
projects.challenge: Engineering teams had limited visibility into their development process. Managers relied on gut feeling rather than data to identify bottlenecks and improve workflows.
projects.solution: Built an analytics platform that integrates with GitHub, Jira, and CI/CD tools to automatically collect and visualize key metrics. Implemented custom dashboards and automated weekly reports.

projects.title: WeatherLens
projects.description: Beautiful weather app with hyperlocal forecasts and interactive radar maps.
projects.longDescription: WeatherLens provides accurate, hyperlocal weather forecasts with a focus on beautiful design and intuitive data visualization.
projects.challenge: Most weather apps are cluttered with ads and provide generic forecasts that don't account for microclimates.
projects.solution: Created a clean, ad-free weather app using multiple weather APIs to provide hyperlocal forecasts. Built custom visualizations for radar, temperature trends, and precipitation probability.
